why_the_probe_misses_it.root_cause: _agent_surface_targets never builds POST agents.<domain>/v1/images/generate. The openapi-derived upstream paths are dropped: (a) _ABS_URL_RE captures trailing markdown punctuation (',' '.' '`' ':' '):') gluing junk onto extracted URLs -> most agent_targets 404 and the referenced openapi.json URL can fail the .endswith('.json') gate; (b) the _dedupe(paths)[:5] cap drops openapi-derived paths behind method-path mentions; (c) the targets[:16] cap drops the tail. So the probe GETs the unpriced upstream (api.driftflight.com/*, 404/200) and POSTs only doc/auth URLs.
